## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals — broad sector participation but Technology is noticeably weak while Energy, Healthcare and Staples show strength, supporting a neutral stance with no clear directional bias.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Staples lead: WMT (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +2.32%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare corollary strength: LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND. Industrials and Financials are mixed but not leading: CAT (1W: -8.71% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND; JPM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND; COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND; VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY; SBUX (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -8.96% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION; AVGO (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND; CSCO (1W: -9.29% | 1M: -2.21%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -9.31% | 1M: -14.53%) BELOW TREND; PLTR (1W: -11.01% | 1M: +5.55%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Technology (4/5 in Bottom 5).

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +7.08% | 1M: -4.42%) RECOVERY, VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY. Note major divergence: multiple large names show 1W vs 1M polarity — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed-to-weak with heavy semiconductor and infrastructure weakness: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -17.22% | 1M: -1.89%) BELOW TREND while ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND and INTU (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +4.32%) ABOVE TREND. Sector 1W: -4.86% (24 stocks) — internal rotation within Tech.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed with payments and select banks leading: V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +9.30%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: +0.87% (20 stocks). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare constructive and broad: LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, MDT (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +2.97%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: +4.03% (17 stocks) — accumulation confirmed by positive news flow on LLY/GILD/ABBV.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to resilient cyclicals and defensive earners — Energy and Healthcare (COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to large-cap semiconductors and tech hardware showing clear downside (AVGO (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND). Monitor broad divergence in Tech for entry/exit signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.31% | 1M: -14.53%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.47% | 1M: +6.28%) — broad strength; Healthcare (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +4.94%). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.86% | 1M: +0.49%) — watch semiconductor group.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA downside confirmation below near-term support of prior swing low (~450 area) would confirm continued BELOW TREND; AAPL support area near prior consolidations (~180) would be key to hold ABOVE TREND; XOM breakout above recent highs (~120) would confirm continuation ABOVE TREND; ACN sustaining above recent gap (~430) would confirm momentum ABOVE TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+80): LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. BA (+80): BA (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND — positive FAA news but price not yet confirming, watch for follow-through. ACN (+50): ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/news confirmed by strong price. XOM (+60): XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
T (-50): AT&T cited negative — monitor communication peers VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY and TMUS (1W: +7.08% | 1M: -4.42%) RECOVERY for divergence. SRE (-55): Sempra flagged negative — watch Utilities group after CEG (1W: -8.96% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION. MMM (-45): target cut noted — MMM (price data not highlighted in main extract) — monitor industrials where LMT (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: pronounced Tech weakness and multiple 1W/1M divergences — watch for trend confirmation and news-driven distribution (LLY/BA headlines notable).
